faq.question: How much does a website or web app cost?
faq.answer: Every project is priced by a written quote with the scope, price and delivery dates, agreed before any work starts, and you pay only the amounts in that quote. Write to hello@devshipit.com with what you need, when you need it and a rough budget.

faq.question: How long does a project take?
faq.answer: It depends on the scope. The delivery dates are written into your quote before any work starts, so you know them up front.

faq.question: Who owns the code and the website?
faq.answer: You do. For freelance work, ownership of what is built passes to you once it is paid for, unless the quote says otherwise.

faq.question: How is the work delivered?
faq.answer: Online: a live website, a code repository or files, on the dates in your quote. Nothing is shipped physically.

faq.question: What if I need to cancel a project?
faq.answer: Cancellation and refund terms for a project, including any advance, are written into the quote you accept before work starts.

faq.question: What do you build with?
faq.answer: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Docker and Socket.IO. Websites for property agents are usually built on the MERN stack.

faq.question: How quickly do you reply?
faq.answer: Within 2 working days, usually sooner. Email is the fastest way to reach me.

faq.question: Is Dev Agarwalla open to full-time roles?
faq.answer: Yes. Dev is looking for an entry-level software engineer or full-stack developer role in Bangalore. Write to hello@devshipit.com.

faq.question: What is DevShipIt, and how is it related to JantaHR?
faq.answer: DevShipIt is the trading name of Dev Agarwalla, a full-stack developer in Bengaluru, and this is its website. JantaHR is HR and payroll software for Indian companies that DevShipIt builds and sells at jantahr.devshipit.com.

contact.note: Use hello@devshipit.com for jobs, interviews and freelance projects. Use jantahr@devshipit.com only for JantaHR support, billing and legal questions.
